title: KGB department researching unknown flying and underwater objects

tellings.quote: president showed to our leader. Back then, there was a special department of administration within the KGB of the USSR for researching these unknown flying and not just flying, but also underwater objects.

plain: In the Soviet Union there was a special department inside the KGB that researched unknown flying objects, and also unknown objects under water. Kiran Ilum Xenov, a former president of one of Russia's republics, tells Michels this was shown to his own leader by Mikhail Gorbachev; if true, the Soviet secret police studied such objects in an organised way.
